definitions.compliance_fix_2026_07_12: pre-publish, disclosed: headline decided_rate/control_lift had been computed on the all-calls cohort, contradicting the registered maturity rule; pinned to the matured cohort before first publish (that day: decided rate 24.6% -> 28.7%, lift 1.36x -> 1.31x)
definitions.decided_rate: wins (open_toward + closed_caught_up) / (wins + open_away + retired_we_backed_off), matured cohort only
definitions.headline_cohort: calls at least 14 days old (registered maturity rule); younger decided calls surface in summary.immature_decided
definitions.noise_floor: max(10 spots, 15% of the call's initial gap)
definitions.one_sided_note: conservative: only credits the field coming toward ValuCast, never widening-right calls
definitions.retreat_attribution: divergence closes -> whichever side moved more; ties count against ValuCast
definitions.stabilized_2026_07_13: ADDITIVE, pre-registered forward: the daily metric re-rolls against the latest board each build and a single reading swings wide (7/12 lift 1.31x vs 7/13 1.00x). summary.stabilized reports the trailing 14-build mean and min/max of the SAME daily numbers, replayed from the committed archive. The frozen daily scoring is unchanged; this only summarizes it so a noisy single day isn't read as a track record.

targets.usage: pre-registered accountability targets, display-only; the model never optimizes toward this scorecard
